accountSecurity.emailHint: We'll send a confirmation link. Your email changes once you tap it.
accountSecurity.emailSent: Check your new email for a confirmation link. Until you tap it, keep signing in with your current email.
accountSecurity.title: Password and email
across.intro: Someone from another faith community asked for prayer. You only see one request a day like this.
across.title: Pray across lines
across.toggleHint: Once a day, see a request from someone in another faith community who also said yes, and let them see yours.
actions.alreadyAsked: You have already asked them to pray for this.
actions.alreadyCommitted: You are already praying %{frequency} for this request.
actions.askDone: Sent. They will see that you asked them to pray.
actions.commitDone: Your commitment is saved. We will remind you when it is time to pray.
actions.followToAsk: Follow people to ask them to pray for requests.
actions.giftNote: Tokens help more people see this request. No one is ever hidden for lacking tokens.
actions.giveDone: Thank you. More people will see this request.
actions.integrity: Tapping means you are bringing this request before the Lord right now.
actions.poolDone: Thank you. %{count} tokens from “%{name}” will help more people see this request.
actions.prayingDone: Thank you. They will know someone is praying for them right now.
actions.queued: Thank you. You're offline, so this will be sent as soon as you're back online.
actions.reportDone: Thank you. A moderator will review this.
actions.reportNote: A moderator will look at it. The person is not told who reported it.
actions.scheduledOnce: Scheduled. %{count} tokens will go to this request on %{when}. Tokens are taken then; see Scheduled gifts in your profile.
actions.scheduledRepeat: Scheduled. %{count} tokens will go to this request on %{when}, then weekly for %{weeks} weeks in all. Tokens are taken then; see Scheduled gifts in your profile.
actions.shareDone: Shared. Thank you for spreading the word.
admin.acksHint: When on, a prayer counts as heard on the air only once a listener decodes it. If no listener hears it in time, the station sends it again. It only resends while a listener node is running.
admin.acksStats: Today: %{heard} heard, %{waiting} waiting for a listener, %{unheard} not heard after every try, %{retried} sent again.
admin.acksTimeout: Send again if nobody heard it within
admin.aiConnected: An AI is connected (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set).
admin.aiNotConnected: No AI is connected. Until ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set on the server, members get fixed answers.
admin.amplify: Amplify sends a prayer %{count} times (free, or at the Amplify price set under Tokens). “1,000x a second” is not possible on PSK31, about one prayer a minute.
admin.amplifyBurstHint: More than 50 copies needs a station in burst mode, which sends 1,000 copies in about half a second. A PSK31 station sends at most 50.
admin.btn.selectWinners: Offer the award to the top pray-ers
admin.burstsNone: No bursts yet. The station logs each one here once BURST_MODE is set.
admin.ceaselessHint: Members can keep their own request on the air. When nothing else is waiting and the station has been quiet for the time below, one kept request goes out again, the one sent longest ago first. Members' new prayers always go first.
admin.communitiesHint: A community that is on can be chosen by members on their Me page. Open Circle is the non-religious community: its members see warm everyday wording with no religious words, and only its own posts.
admin.communityCreated: %{name} was created. It's hidden until you turn it on.
admin.communityFeatures: Features this community gets. Tap one to hide it there: its buttons go away and the server refuses it.
admin.communityNeutral: Neutral wording (no religious words, as in Open Circle)
admin.communityNeutralHint: On: members of this community read plain, everyday wording and see no scripture.
admin.communityOnHint: On: members can choose it. Off: hidden from new members; current members stay.
admin.communityTypes: Kinds of post members can make. Discussion, News and Blog Post are posts that aren't prayed for: people comment, encourage and share.
admin.confirmDelete: Tap again to delete for good
admin.dailyCap: Radio sends per member a day (an amplified one counts each time it goes out)
admin.deletionHint: From the web page. Confirm with the person by email before deleting.
admin.downloadSponsor: Sponsor report, %{weeks} weeks (HTML, print to PDF)
admin.everyRequest: Every request on the air once
admin.everyRequestHint: Every new prayer request that may go on the radio is sent once, free, after the prayers members sent themselves. Sensitive requests and laments kept off the radio are left out.
admin.everyoneLimits: Limits for everyone (admins and moderators are exempt; 0 = no limit). The same request or comment can't be posted twice in a day.
admin.field.aiChatLimit: Conversation messages per member each day
admin.field.aiFacLimit: Facilitator messages per member each day
admin.field.allocationMax: Most radio prayers a member can ask for at once
admin.field.amplifyCost: Amplify price in Priestly tokens while radio prayers cost tokens (empty = Amplify only when free)
admin.field.autoPrayLimit: Most AI prayers a day, all requests together
admin.field.autoPrayPerDay: AI prayers per request per day (1 to 4)
admin.field.awardNote: Other prize, described to winners (handled outside the app)
admin.field.communityOperator: Run by (a partner church or group; leave empty if you run it)
admin.field.communitySlug: Short name (lowercase letters, numbers and dashes)
admin.field.confessionDays: Days a closed confession is kept before it is erased (0 = erase when closed)
admin.field.donateUrl: Donation page address (for example your Zeffy form)
admin.field.everyoneMonthly: Free radio prayers for every member each month
admin.field.jitsiUrl: Video server address (Jitsi Meet), e.g. https://meet.example.org
admin.field.liveMinutes: Hide a room as live after this many minutes
admin.field.perDay: Messages a day for new members
admin.field.prayers: Prayers for others to lift limits
admin.field.requests: Messages before the other person replies
admin.field.spokenOffer: Most tokens a member may offer per spoken prayer
admin.field.tierUpkeepDays: Tier upkeep: days allowed between giving or spending a token
admin.field.verifiedPerDay: Verified prayers a day per member (0 = no cap)
admin.giftFrom: Given by a member (optional; they get the thank-you tokens)
admin.giftRefunded: Gift marked refunded. The giver’s thank-you tokens were taken back if they still had them.
admin.healthHeardNone: No listener has reported a decode yet.
admin.healthHint: When on, this shows each station's last check-in, what is waiting, the signal listeners measured on each preset today, and today's failures.
admin.healthSnr: %{callSign} on %{preset}: average %{avg} dB, lowest %{min} dB (%{reports} reports)
admin.healthStation: %{callSign}: last check-in %{when}. Today %{bursts} bursts, %{prayers} prayers, %{failed} failed.
admin.heardTrailHint: The member who sent a radio prayer and the person who asked see each listener node that decoded it, with its signal, and how many phones did. Only real reports, never an estimate.
admin.listenPageHint: When on, anyone can open /listen on the website with a phone or laptop near a radio and read the prayers in each burst as it plays. The decoding happens on their device. See docs/RADIO_BURST.md.
admin.listenerKey: Key for %{name}, shown only now. Put it in NODE_KEY on a listener, or STATION_API_KEY on a station: %{key}
admin.listenerModeHint: When on, the sign-in screen offers "Listen to radio prayers", so anyone near a radio can decode bursts with the app, without an account. The listening page must be on too.
admin.listenerModeInactive: Turn on the listening page above for listener mode to show.
admin.listenerName: Name for the new listener or station
admin.listenersHint: Listener nodes are receive-only Raspberry Pis with a radio. They decode the station's bursts and report the signal strength they measured, so a station on BURST_PRESET=auto (with BURST_AUTO_REPORT=server) picks the fastest preset every listener can still decode. They never send prayers' words.
admin.materialMatch.fulfill: Record that this help was sent
admin.materialMatch.hint: Each radio prayer paid with Priestly tokens records help of equal value owed to people in need. Record it here when you send it; it shows on the Common Prayer Fund report.
admin.materialMatch.kind: What you gave (e.g. groceries, rent help)
admin.materialMatch.rate: Value of one Priestly token, in cents
admin.materialMatch.recorded: Recorded $%{amount} of help sent in the Common Prayer Fund.
admin.materialMatch.title: Equal material help
admin.materialMatch.toggle: Match paid radio prayers with material help
admin.milestonesHint: Bonus tokens for reaching a milestone, given once per member. Every rule is off until you turn it on.
admin.multiStationHint: Several stations can share one queue. Each extra station gets its own key (use it as STATION_API_KEY on that station). A prayer goes to only one station, and only that station can report it sent. The main station's key keeps working.
admin.newCommunityHint: A denomination's own space, or one run by a partner church or faith group. It starts hidden, and members join only by choosing it.
admin.onAirHint: When on, anyone can open /on-the-air on the website to see how many prayers the station sent and its latest bursts. Counts only: never the words, and never who sent or asked.
admin.operatorAlertsHint: Sends radio operators and admins a notice when a station problem starts (no sound card, the radio did not key, a failed burst, overdue prayers, a station that stopped reporting), and a quiet note when it clears.
admin.operatorLogHint: A spreadsheet (CSV) of each transmission in the last 30 days: time (UTC), call sign, station, frequency, preset, status and the exact text sent.
admin.paused: The station is paused: turn on “Radio prayers are free” above.
admin.prayingTooSwitchHint: A listener who decoded a prayer can tap it. Only a fingerprint goes back, when they're online, and the person who asked is told someone is praying too. The count is anonymous.
admin.radioBeaconHint: The station sends one short test burst on a schedule, and every listener node or listening page that decodes it is logged with its signal, so the operator console shows reception through the day. Never while held or outside the transmission windows.
admin.radioBurstHint: A station with BURST_MODE set claims up to this many prayers and sends them compressed in one short burst. A PSK31 station still sends one at a time. See docs/RADIO_BURST.md.
admin.radioConsoleHint: One screen for the control operator: the queue, the transmission window, each station's ID timer, the log, and hold or send-now overrides. Give someone the Radio operator role to let them use it.
admin.radioFreeHint: On: radio prayers cost nothing and Priestly tokens are donations only. Off: each radio prayer spends Priestly tokens.
admin.radioNeedHint: Donations fill a shared fund and prayers go out free: the most urgent first, then the one with the fewest people praying, then the oldest.
admin.radioUrgentFirstHint: Requests marked Today or Right now go out before the rest of the queue, whichever order the rest follows.
admin.receiptsHint: When on, a member who sends a radio prayer is told when it went out and on which preset. If a listener's /listen page or Listen screen decodes it, the sender and the person who asked are told it was heard. Listeners send back only a fingerprint of each prayer, never the words.
admin.recordGift: Record a gift that came another way (cash, check, Zeffy or PayPal). Choose where it goes.
admin.saved.ruleAdded: Milestone added. Turn it on when ready.
admin.scheduleHint: When on, the station only sends inside a window and outside quiet hours. Outside them, prayers wait in the queue.
admin.scheduleNow.off: The station is off the air now.
admin.scheduleQuiet: Quiet hours, start and end (HH:MM, blank for none)
admin.scheduleWindows: Windows (none means any time outside quiet hours)
admin.scheduledRadioHint: Members can set a request to go out by radio, or amplified, at a chosen time, once or weekly. The radio prayer's price and rules apply when the time comes.
admin.signalQueueHint: Members see their own radio prayers: waiting, going out, sent or not sent, with a signal code for each one that went out. A listener who decodes it sees the same code on the Listen screen.
admin.signedReportsHint: Each listener node must sign its reports with its key (LISTEN_SIGN=on) instead of sending the key. Turn on only after every node is updated: an unsigned node is then refused.
admin.skyHint: For a dish pointed at the sky: shows on the operator console where the target is now and when it rises or sets, and the station can turn a rotator to follow it (ROTATOR=rotctld).
admin.skyHold: Hold transmissions while the target is too low
admin.skyHoldHint: Nothing goes out while the target is below the lowest useful elevation. The operator console override does not lift this.
admin.skyNeedsPlace: Enter the dish location to see where to point.
admin.standing: Prayers: %{prayers} · Promise check-ins: %{checkins} · People prayed for: %{people}
admin.stationAlert.listener_silent: A listener node stopped checking in.
admin.stationAlert.no_audio_device: No sound card at the station.
admin.stationAlert.queue_empty: Nothing is waiting to go out.
admin.stationAlertsHint: When on, this shows when the station has no sound card, the radio did not key, a burst failed or is overdue, or the station stopped reporting, and tells admins in the app. The station reports its checks about once a minute.
admin.stationCount: %{name}: sending %{sending}, sent %{sent} in the last 24 hours
admin.stationOverdue: Overdue when a prayer has waited
admin.stripeKeysMissing: Stripe needs STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the server before the Give button shows.
admin.thanksgivingBurst: Thanksgiving on the air for answered requests
admin.thanksgivingBurstHint: When a member marks answered a request that went out by radio, one short thanksgiving is queued for the station, free. It is sent like any other radio prayer.
admin.tiersHint: Leave a box empty to keep it undecided.
admin.toggle.aiChatHint: A role-play with an AI that always says it is not God. Hidden from Open Circle members. Conversations are not saved.
admin.toggle.aiFacilitatorHint: An AI asks the restorative questions before a circle. Members can send a summary to moderators.
admin.toggle.allocationRequests: Members can ask for more radio prayers
admin.toggle.allocationRequestsHint: Staff grant or decline each request on Me → Radio prayer requests. Granted prayers are paid from the shared fund.
admin.toggle.anyPrayerHint: Off: only people who committed to pray.
admin.toggle.autoPrayHint: The person who asked can have an AI write a short prayer for their request each day. Each one is labeled as written by an AI and counted apart; it never counts as a prayer by a person, never earns tokens and never goes on the radio. Needs the AI key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Never offered in Open Circle or for a request in crisis.
admin.toggle.automationRuleHint: Adds a rule against bots, scripts and AI-written posts passed off as a member's own words, and lets moderators cite it.
admin.toggle.awardHint: Admins offer the award to the year's top pray-ers; winners accept or decline and choose whether the Hall shows their name. Token prizes are paid on acceptance.
admin.toggle.care: Members can ask for a prayer partner
admin.toggle.checkinAffirmationHint: The Promises tab says that checking in affirms you truly prayed for the person, as in the concept document's check-in step.
admin.toggle.circleGoalsHint: The person who asked (or staff) can set a shared goal on a request, such as 50 people praying for it within a week. Progress counts different people who really prayed.
admin.toggle.confessionHint: Members can confess privately to a pastor or counselor (never a prayer partner). It is erased the set number of days after it is closed.
admin.toggle.crossCommunityHint: Members of faith communities who opt in see one request a day from another faith community whose author also opted in. Never Open Circle.
admin.toggle.crosspostHint: Members can have their own Facebook and Threads posts copied to their account here, by the browser extension or by connecting the account (docs/CROSSPOST.md).
admin.toggle.givingAskHint: Once giving is set up, each member sees one small card in the feed after 28 days here, the way Mastodon asks. It is easy to dismiss, never shown again, and never shown to someone who already gave.
admin.toggle.givingHint: Members see Give on Me. Gifts fill the shared fund or a token pool, and givers earn regular tokens. Giving never changes what anyone sees in the feed.
admin.toggle.groupGiftsHint: Members can give tokens to a group chat they belong to, or to the people going to an event. The tokens are split evenly among the others there (never across a block), as ordinary gifts; any remainder stays with the giver.
admin.toggle.kindCloud: Kind cloud ("What would Ted Lasso do?")
admin.toggle.kindCloudHint: A small cloud with a short prayer asks "Are you sure you want to put that out there?" when words look aimed at someone. It asks more firmly about a threat or a stream of swearing, but never stops a post. Swearing out of pain gets no cloud. Replaces the older rules warning while on.
admin.toggle.lampsHint: Members can thank someone in their community with a short note on their profile, like Wikipedia's barnstar. Recognition only: no tokens. Each member can give a few a week (3 unless changed in the database setting lamps_per_week).
admin.toggle.limitNewHint: New until they have been here long enough and prayed for others enough times. Admins and moderators are exempt.
admin.toggle.liveHint: Staff start rooms; members of the same community see them under "Live now". Without a video server, hosts paste a link from an allowed meeting site.
admin.toggle.meaningReactionsHint: Under a post, a tap on 🙏 ❤️ 🫂 💪 🎉 🕯️ adds a leaf with a kind word ("Feel better"). Press and hold an emoji for up to five meanings.
admin.toggle.memberTownHint: Members can add a town. It shows only to members of their own community, for example "Carol in Albuquerque".
admin.toggle.misleadingRuleHint: Adds a rule against false health, money or safety claims and made-up news to Community rules, and lets moderators cite it.
admin.toggle.mutual: Only between people who follow each other
admin.toggle.mutualHint: Off: anyone can send a message request.
admin.toggle.podcastsHint: Members find staff podcasts on Me, and each published show has a public RSS feed for podcast apps.
admin.toggle.poolLedgerHint: Me → Token pools shows, for the member's community, how many tokens members put into pools, how many were matched, how many reached requests and how many went back. Totals only; it names no one.
admin.toggle.poolMatchingHint: A pool's donor can promise to match other members' gifts to it, up to a cap. When the pool closes, what's left goes back to everyone who gave, by share.
admin.toggle.postLines: Lines that show whose post it is
admin.toggle.postLinesHint: A line runs from the poster's name with the post type above it, and down the left side of the post, as in the first post mockups.
admin.toggle.prayerListHint: Members keep a private list of people and topics to pray for, with an optional daily or weekly reminder ("Did you remember to pray for Grandma today?"). Only the member sees it; marking someone prayed for earns no tokens.
admin.toggle.prayerMessages: Pray-ers can write to people they prayed for
admin.toggle.pressureRuleHint: Adds the rule on sharing beliefs without pressuring anyone to Community rules, and lets moderators cite it.
admin.toggle.prizeChoice: Award winners choose what happens to the prize
admin.toggle.prizeChoiceHint: When accepting the annual award, the winner chooses to keep the prize, donate it, or split it.
admin.toggle.promisePageHint: Shows /promise on the website: no ads, no selling information, no ad tracking.
admin.toggle.reactionTrayHint: Pressing and holding a post opens "Light a candle" and "Standing with you". The author sees how many of each.
admin.toggle.readingPlanHint: Admins and pastors set a plan of daily passages (Me → Bible reading plan). Members see today's passage, open it on Bible Gateway (World English Bible; database setting reading_plan_url), mark it read and see how many read it today. Never shown in Open Circle.
admin.toggle.sermonInputsHint: People coming to an event can tell the host what to pray about or preach on. Only the host and staff see them.
admin.toggle.spokenHint: Members who prayed can record a short voice prayer for requests whose authors turned them on. Authors may offer tokens, paid when they listen.
admin.toggle.squireBoardHint: The public track from the concept document. Members who opt in appear on a board of verified prayers for others in their own community over the last 30 days (database setting squire_board_days), and get a Prayer Squire label on their profile. Anonymous members are never shown.
admin.toggle.stationFree: Station sends only while radio prayers are free
admin.toggle.stationFreeHint: Amateur radio rules (47 CFR 97.113) forbid tying a transmission to payment. Keep this on for an amateur station.
admin.toggle.supportLabelHint: Posters can welcome support from people of any faith or none.
admin.toggle.supportLinksHint: Members can add their own Ko-fi, Patreon, Buy Me a Coffee, PayPal.me, Liberapay, GitHub Sponsors, Zeffy or Open Collective page to their profile, so money stays outside the community. Only members of the same community see it.
admin.toggle.thanksCardHint: Invites members to post a praise when they haven't lately, and counts answered requests they prayed for.
admin.toggle.tierUpkeep: Keep tiers up by giving or spending tokens
admin.toggle.tierUpkeepHint: A member above the first tier who has not given or spent a token within the days below shows, and is resupplied at, one tier lower until they do. Prayers they earned are never taken away.
admin.toggle.twoStepHint: Members can add an authenticator app on Me → Password and email, then enter its 6-digit code after their password. Turning this off hides it from new members; members who already use it keep it.
admin.toggle.urgencyGlowHint: The colored light on an urgent or very urgent request glows and pulses gently. It stays still for anyone whose device asks for reduced motion.
admin.toggle.waitlistHint: Shows /waitlist on the website, where people leave an email to be invited. Admins invite them from Admin → Waitlist.
admin.toggle.whyGifts: Why we run on gifts, not ads
admin.toggle.whyGiftsHint: Shows the page on Me and at /why-donations on the website. The give button appears once giving is set up (Admin → Giving).
admin.toggle.witnessStoriesHint: The Witness team can share how someone was helped, only after that person approves the exact words. Never shows names.
admin.toggle.worldwideHint: Feed shows how many prayers were offered in the last day; Me shows how many people prayed for your requests. Real counts, no names.
admin.toneHint: Members can choose for themselves; this is the default for everyone else.
admin.toneResult: %{tone}: %{prayed} of %{shown} reminders led to a prayer (last 30 days)
admin.warriorsHint: Verified prayers for others and kept promises. Private to admins until award rules are approved.
admin.zeffyConnected: Zeffy is connected. Its gifts are recorded on their own and matched to members by email.
admin.zeffyNoWebhook: Zeffy is connected, but without ZEFFY_WEBHOOK_TOKEN gifts come in only when you tap "Get gifts from Zeffy now".
admin.zeffyNotConnected: Set ZEFFY_API_KEY on the server and Zeffy gifts are recorded on their own. Until then, record them below.
ai.asked: Sent. A moderator will contact you about a circle.
ai.chatIntro: A role-play to help you reflect and pray. Nothing you write here is saved.
ai.facIntro: A restorative circle is a video meeting, led by a moderator, where people in a disagreement talk face to face. An AI asks you the restorative questions one at a time. Nothing is saved unless you send a summary to a moderator.
ai.facNoAi: No AI is connected, so the questions come one at a time without replies.
ai.placeholder: Write what is on your heart…
aiPrayers.heading: AI prayers (%{count})
aiPrayers.hint: An AI writes a short prayer for this request every day for a few weeks. Only your request's words are sent to the AI (Anthropic), never your name.
aiPrayers.label: Written by an AI, not by a person. They are not counted as prayers and earn no tokens.
aiPrayers.toggle: Have an AI pray for this request
announcements.label: Announcements
announcementsAdmin.endedNotice: Ended. Members no longer see it.
announcementsAdmin.hours: Ends after (hours, blank to keep it up)
announcementsAdmin.intro: Post a message to every member. It shows at the top of their feed until they dismiss it, or until it ends.
announcementsAdmin.kindHint.banner: One short line across the top of the feed.
announcementsAdmin.kindHint.notice: A card with a title and a few sentences.
announcementsAdmin.needTitleEs: Add a Spanish title to go with the Spanish text.
announcementsAdmin.posted: Posted. Members see it the next time they open the feed.
announcementsAdmin.title: Announcements
answeredStory.adminHint: The person who asked can post a short follow-up that links to their request. Everyone who prayed gets a note, and both posts link to each other.
answeredStory.hint: A short story that links back to this request. Everyone who prayed gets a note.
answeredStory.label: How it turned out
appeal.heldIntro: Your post is waiting for a moderator before others see it. If you want, tell them what is going on. They will read this with it.
appeal.heldSent: Thank you. The moderator will read this with your post.
appeal.intro: Tell us why you think this decision was wrong. A moderator will look at it again.
appeal.sent: Thank you. A moderator will look at this again and you will get a notice with the outcome.
appeal.title: Appeal
auditLog.action.POST_macro-needs_id_help: Marked helpers on a macro need
auditLog.action.POST_posts_id_witness: Marked a request for the witness team
auditLog.filterHint: A name, an action or a word
auditLog.intro: Every change staff made, newest first: roles, settings, moderation decisions, witness and care actions. Witness notes are logged without their text.
auditLog.title: Audit log
award.hallIntro: Each year the people who prayed most for others are honored here.
award.heading: Prayer Warrior Award
award.prize: With the award: %{tokens} tokens and %{special} Priestly tokens.
award.prizeChoiceHint: Donated tokens go to the fund that keeps the service running. Splitting gives away half.
award.showName: Show my name in the Hall of Prayer Warriors
award.showNameHint: Off: the Hall lists you as "A Prayer Warrior".
award.thanks: Congratulations, and thank you for praying.
award.why: You prayed for others %{count} times this year, for %{people} people. Thank you.
backupCodes.adminHint: Members with two-step sign-in can make 10 one-time codes. One code turns two-step sign-in off after a lost phone. Five wrong codes lock it for an hour.
backupCodes.adminResetDone: Two-step sign-in is off for %{name}. They were sent a notice.
backupCodes.adminResetSure: Tap again to turn it off
backupCodes.enterIntro: Type one of your backup codes. This turns two-step sign-in off so you can sign in and set it up again.
backupCodes.fileIntro: Backup codes for two-step sign-in. Each works once. Keep them private.
backupCodes.intro: If you lose your phone, a backup code gets you back in. Make a set and keep it somewhere safe, like a password manager or a printed page.
backupCodes.lostPhone: Lost your phone? Use a backup code
backupCodes.makeNewHint: Making new codes stops the old ones from working.
backupCodes.nudge: Make backup codes below in case you lose your phone.
backupCodes.remaining: %{count} unused backup codes. Each works once.
backupCodes.saveNow: Save these now. You won’t see them again. Each code works once.
backupCodes.title: Backup codes
calm.adminHint: When a comment thread heats up (three comments the kind cloud would flag, from two or more people, within two hours), everyone in it sees a calm, Ted Lasso-style note and the thread goes to Moderation. Only a moderator can slow it down (one comment every 10 minutes each); the app never blocks anyone on its own. Only who commented and when is kept, never the words.
calm.queueHint: Conversations that heated up. Nothing has been limited. Read the thread, then choose: it’s fine, or slow it down for 6 hours.
calm.slow: A moderator has slowed this conversation for a while: one comment every %{minutes} minutes each, so there’s room to breathe.
calm.ted: “Be a goldfish.” Let the last sharp word go, and answer with kindness.
calm.title: Let’s take a breath together
calm.warm: This conversation is getting a little warm. Everyone here cares about this person. Be curious, not judgmental, and assume the best of each other.
card.hide: Not for me: hide this post
card.openHint: Opens the request and all comments
care.confessionNote.one: Only a pastor or counselor sees a confession. It is erased 1 day after it is closed.
care.confessionNote.other: Only a pastor or counselor sees a confession. It is erased %{count} days after it is closed.
care.confessionNoteNow: Only a pastor or counselor sees a confession. It is erased as soon as it is closed.
care.intro: Ask, and one of our prayer partners or pastors will reach out to you privately to pray with you.
care.noneWaiting: No one is waiting right now.
care.placeholder: What would you like prayer for?
care.sent: A prayer partner will message you. You'll get a notice when they do.
care.title: Pray with someone
care.unavailable: Prayer partners aren't available right now. Please try again later.
cast.empty: No prayers have gone out yet.
cast.intro: Prayers that went out by radio. Only the words of the request are sent, never a name. Send one from any request with “Send as a radio prayer”.
checkBack.adminHint: The person who asked can pick a gentle reminder (3 days, a week or 2 weeks) to share how it’s going. When they post an update, everyone who prayed gets one quiet in-app heads-up a day, with no push and none of the update’s words.
checkBack.due: We’ll check back with you on %{date}. Post an update any time, and everyone who prayed gets a quiet heads-up.
checkBack.error: That didn’t save. Please try again.
checkBack.hint: Want a gentle reminder to share how it’s going? When you post an update, everyone who prayed gets a quiet heads-up, never a buzz.
checkBack.title: Check back with me
church.about: Anything that helps us check your church (optional)
church.checkHint: A website or phone number helps us verify your church faster.
church.intro: Pastors: add your church to become a Prayer Tower church partner. An admin checks it, usually by phone or your church's website, and then a pastor badge shows on the requests you post under your name.

kindWords.adminHint: A private weekly card on Me with a short, made-up situation and three replies. Tapping one shows gently how it might land, to practise empathy. No scores, no streaks, and nothing a member taps is stored.
kindWords.intro: A made-up moment to try out each week. Tap a reply to see how it might land. There are no scores, and nothing you tap is saved.
kindWords.s0.n0: Hope is kind, but said this fast it can feel like being hurried past the hurt.
kindWords.s0.n1: Naming the hurt tells them they were heard. People often feel less alone when someone simply stays with them.
kindWords.s0.n2: Advice can help later. Right now it may sound like the reason was them.
kindWords.s0.r0: Something better is coming, I’m sure of it!
kindWords.s0.r1: That’s really hard, especially after hoping again. I’m sorry.
kindWords.s0.r2: Have you thought about changing your résumé?
kindWords.s0.situation: Someone writes: “I didn’t get the job. Again.”
kindWords.s1.n0: Warmth plus naming the distance meets them where they are.
kindWords.s1.n1: “At least” can quietly shrink what they feel, even when it’s meant to comfort.
kindWords.s1.n2: Sharing your story can connect, but it can also turn the spotlight away. Ask about them first.
kindWords.s1.r0: I’m thinking of you and your dad tonight. Being far away must be so hard.
kindWords.s1.r1: At least he’s in good hands.
kindWords.s1.r2: My mom was in the hospital last year, it was awful.
kindWords.s1.situation: Someone writes: “My dad is in the hospital and I can’t be there.”
kindWords.s2.n0: Defending yourself is natural, but it usually raises the temperature.
kindWords.s2.n1: Assuming the best and asking cools things down and keeps the door open. Be curious, not judgmental.
kindWords.s2.n2: Calling out the tone often starts a second argument about the tone.
kindWords.s2.r1: You’re right that I may have missed something. What did I get wrong?
kindWords.s2.r2: Wow, no need to be rude.
kindWords.s2.situation: Someone replies sharply: “You clearly didn’t read what I wrote.”
kindWords.s3.n0: Short is fine, but a little more shows you noticed what it cost them.
kindWords.s3.n1: Celebrating the effort, not only the result, is what people remember.
kindWords.s3.n2: A warning on a happy day can take the joy out of it, even when you care.
kindWords.s3.r1: Three months! That takes real courage, day after day. So glad for you.
kindWords.s3.r2: Just don’t let your guard down now.
kindWords.s3.situation: Someone shares good news: “I’m three months sober today.”
kindWords.s4.n0: A first reply often decides whether a newcomer comes back.
kindWords.s4.n1: Silence isn’t unkind, but a newcomer may read it as nobody noticing.
kindWords.s4.n2: Pointing to a better place gently, with a welcome first, helps more than a correction alone.
kindWords.s4.r2: You posted this in the wrong place.
kindWords.s4.situation: Someone new posts for the first time, a little awkwardly.
kindWords.s5.n0: “Cheer up” can feel like being told the feeling is wrong.
kindWords.s5.n1: Asking what they need lets them lead. If they ever speak of harming themselves, the Safety page has people to call.
kindWords.s5.n2: Tips can wait. First, let them know they were heard.
kindWords.s5.r0: Cheer up, it could be worse!
kindWords.s5.r1: That sounds heavy. Do you want to talk about it, or would you like some company in it?
kindWords.s5.situation: Someone says: “I just feel tired of everything lately.”
kindWords.title: Kind words practice

rulesPage.automation.body: Every account belongs to one real person who writes their own posts. Please don't run bots or scripts that post, react or message for you, create accounts for anyone else, or paste in AI-written requests and comments as if they were your own words. Using a tool to help you say what you mean is fine. Moderators can remove automated posts and suspend accounts that keep doing it.
rulesPage.automation.title: No automated accounts
rulesPage.howTo: To report something, tap Report on the request, comment, message or event. To stop someone reaching you, open their profile and tap Block.
rulesPage.items.0.body: Bring any need, in any state. Desperate prayers, small prayers and prayers you are not sure how to say are all welcome here.
rulesPage.items.0.title: We do not judge
rulesPage.items.1.body: “Keep my son safe” and “Let this war end” are prayers. Prayers that call for harm to anyone, such as “I pray we kill them all,” are forbidden and will be removed.
rulesPage.items.1.title: Pray for good, never for harm
rulesPage.items.2.body: Tokens can help a request reach more people, but no one may flood the feed to push one side of a conflict. Coordinated pile-ons are removed.
rulesPage.items.2.title: No flooding for a side
rulesPage.items.3.body: Disagree in love. Insults, threats, mockery and pile-ons against anyone, in requests, comments or encouragements, are removed.
rulesPage.items.3.title: No harassment or abuse
rulesPage.items.4.body: If you are struggling, please post: you will see a crisis line you can reach any time, and people will pray with you. Details of methods are removed to keep others safe, and you are welcome to post again without them.
rulesPage.items.4.title: No details of suicide or self-harm methods
rulesPage.items.5.body: Prayer Tower has no ads. A prayer request used to sell something or promote a business is an ad, and is penalized.
rulesPage.items.5.title: No ads
rulesPage.items.6.body: You can post and pray anonymously. Others see “Anonymous”; your prayers still count toward your own record.
rulesPage.items.6.title: Anonymous is always allowed
rulesPage.items.7.body: Tokens pay for the infrastructure and extend a request’s reach. They never cash out, and a lack of tokens never stops a request from being seen.
rulesPage.items.7.title: Tokens
rulesPage.items.8.body: Anyone can report a request or comment. Automated checks only flag content; they hide it right away only in the most severe cases, until a person reviews it. A human moderator decides every penalty: removing the post, forfeiting tokens, suspension or reversing token transfers. Every decision is logged, you are told which rule applied, and you can appeal once from your notices.
rulesPage.items.8.title: How moderation works
rulesPage.misleading.body: Share what you know, and say plainly when something is your opinion, a rumor or a story you heard. Please don't post health, money or safety claims you know are false, made-up quotes or news, or edited photos or video meant to fool people. Moderators can remove a post that misleads people in a way that could hurt them, and can add a note pointing to a reliable source.
rulesPage.misleading.title: No misleading claims
rulesPage.partOf: These rules are part of our
rulesPage.pressure.body: You're welcome to share what God has done for you, quote Scripture, and invite someone to pray, talk or visit your church. Please don't keep pushing after someone says "no thanks", ignores you or blocks you; tell anyone their church, tradition or prayers are false or worthless; use a prayer request, or someone's crisis, to argue doctrine or recruit them; or ask for money, sign-ups or contact details as part of sharing faith. Disagreeing kindly is fine. Mocking or attacking anyone's beliefs is not.
rulesPage.pressure.title: Share your beliefs freely. Don't pressure people.
